Thanks for sending the draft MSA and order form earlier. Attached are Mendr's redlines (PDF) — we focused the edits on Sections 12 and 14 (Confidentiality and Publicity). Our concerns are:

- A carve-out for aggregate telemetry data — we need a clear non-personal data exception for performance metrics.
- A narrow publicity clause — request that any press release referencing us require a 10-business-day review period.
- Logo usage: permission for limited co-branding for the press release only; we asked to limit logo placement and a max size spec.

We also attached our brand guidelines and a small logo ZIP (see attachment stub). Please confirm who from Redwood's side will own the security/compliance evidence (SOC 2 report) and where we should upload it.

Hi all,

I've reviewed Mendr's redlines. Below are tracked suggestions and a short clean clause set we can insert to resolve the three items listed. I'm pasting the key proposed edits inline for clarity — feel free to pull into the redline PDF.

1) Telemetry/aggregate data carve-out (proposed new subclause to Confidentiality Section 12):
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, Customer data that has been anonymized or aggregated such that it does not constitute Personal Data or identifiable information (\"Aggregate Data\") shall not be considered Confidential Information. Redwood may use Aggregate Data for internal analytics, service improvement, and de-identified benchmarking, provided such use does not identify Customer or its end users."

2) Publicity / press-release review window (Publicity Section 14):
"Each party must provide the other party with proposed publicity materials referencing the other party at least ten (10) business days prior to public dissemination for review and approval, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld. The reviewing party may request non-material edits for accuracy; material disagreements will be escalated per Section X (Escalation)."

Comment: To preserve our launch playbook we can add a short carve that allows Redwood to publish a joint announcement earlier if the customer provides explicit written waiver in a single email thread. That keeps flexibility if Mendr wants an earlier go-live.

3) Logo usage / placement: suggest inserting a small exhibit (Exhibit A — Logo Guidelines) that references the uploaded brand-guidelines.pdf and requires prior written approval for usage outside the agreed press release.

Evidence/SOC2: Claire — please upload the file to the Drive folder Hannah linked and share view permissions with security@redwoodinference.com. We'll record receipt in the HubSpot deal record.

I'll prepare a tracked-change PDF and a clean clause bundle for signature.

Best,
Irene Choi

- Telemetry carve-out: accepted as written.
- Publicity review: accepted, but please change the phrase "not to be unreasonably withheld" to "not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed." Our comms team insists on the explicit call-out to avoid indefinite holds.
- Logo usage: accepted with Exhibit A; Claire will upload the high-res PNG and a brief trademark checklist by EOD tomorrow.
- Customer quote: Claire confirms a 15-word quote is fine; she'll send the exact wording for approval.
